title: Activation Steering for Bias Mitigation: An Interpretable Approach to Safer LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical methodology of activation steering and linear probes to mitigate societal biases (including gender, race, and religion) in LLMs. While it discusses the goal of creating safer and more ethical models, it does not include a dedicated evaluation or benchmarking component centered on religion, morals, or ethics.
